title: Vet Clinic Office-Visit Relief Table — Tailwise Grooming Salon Prepaid Pass Late-Cancellation Fees
content:
Relief table for the pass late-cancellation fee on prepaid Tailwise Grooming Salon passes (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom and Spa Groom passes), read against the pet's plan under Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans.

**Rule.** The clinic relief on the pass late-cancellation fee follows the pet's Tailwise Vet Clinic wellness plan and the latest office visit redeemed on it, counted in calendar days from that office visit to the cancelled appointment date (the appointment date on the most recently recorded cancellation on the pass with a fee remedy):

| Pet's wellness plan | Latest office visit redeemed on the plan | Clinic relief |
|---|---|---|
| status active | 0 to 2 days before the appointment | 100 percent |
| status active | more than 2 and no more than 14 days before the appointment | 50 percent |
| any other case | — | none |

Telehealth consultations, wellness exams and other services are not office visits.

**How the relief is applied.** The relief reduces the pass late-cancellation fee once, by its percentage. Where the fee carries more than one percentage relief, the reliefs are first added into one relief percentage, never above 100 percent, and the fee is reduced once by that combined percentage; the reliefs do not act one after the other.

**Boundary days (hypothetical active plan, appointment on 20 May)**

| Latest office visit redeemed | Days before the appointment | Clinic relief |
|---|---|---|
| 20 May | 0 | 100 percent |
| 18 May | 2 | 100 percent |
| 17 May | 3 | 50 percent |
| 6 May | 14 | 50 percent |
| 5 May | 15 | none |
| 22 May (after the appointment) | — | none |
| a wellness exam on 19 May, last office visit on 1 May | 19 | none |

**Other cases giving none.** A plan in any status other than active, a pet with no wellness plan, or a plan with no office visit redeemed on it.

On a hypothetical fee of 24.00 with no other relief, 50 percent clinic relief leaves 12.00 and 100 percent leaves 0.00.
